title: 第255章 金琉璃第254章 主殿开启故人来
slug: 听我解释真不是你们想的那样
content_zh:
第255章金琉璃
“我们就是在秘境之中探索，见到一传送阵……就到这边了！”
“传送阵？你们来自哪里？”
“东域！”
“东域？”众人一惊。
“为何东域的传送阵，会直接传送到秘境之中？莫非是这里的前辈，在东域也留下过传承？”
“别问那些没用的！小子，告诉我们，里面都有什么？”
“额……我们还没有仔细看，只是看到一个门，就打开看看，没想到有这么多前辈！”
“就只有你们两个过来？”
“那倒不是。”
林天话没说完，主殿的大门内便又传来了脚步声。
这次的脚步声更密集一些，显然有不少的人手。
然后，他们看到了一个女子。
她走在所有人的最前面。
那一刻，整个陨仙殿外嘈杂的声音戛然而止。
在场的大乘期修士们，无论来自哪个势力，无论平日里多么目中无人，在看到那张脸的瞬间，表情都有所凝固。
那是一个看上去不过双十年华的女子。
她的美，有一种极具侵略性的惊艳。
五官精致得像是用最上等的灵玉一刀一刀雕琢而成，眉若远山含黛，眼似寒潭映月，鼻梁挺直而秀气，神情冷酷。
像是世间万物都入不了她的眼。

高挑而玲珑的身段，被一身紧身衣勾勒得淋漓尽致。
当然，美貌并不能让众人震惊，令他们真正震惊的，还是她的修为。
大乘后期！
一个看上去，像是一个少女的大乘后期！
不过好在中州亦是卧虎藏龙，大势力也不缺乏，很快便有人认出了她。
“金琉璃……是金琉璃！东域金家的那位嫡女！”一个合体期的修士失声喊了出来。
“金家不是隐世不出吗？怎么连她都来中州了？”
旁边的人压低声音，语气中满是震惊。
“金家的嫡女，40岁的大乘后期……我的天，这种天赋还让不让人活了。我修炼三百年，才合体期，她40岁就大乘后期了……”
“如果是金家带队的话，那就不奇怪了，超级世家，有这个底蕴！”
随着众人开口讨论，门后出现越来越多的人，不过他们都是一身仆人的装扮。
那些仆人个个气息内敛，但偶尔泄出的一丝波动，至少也是合体中期起步。
陆沉站在人群的最外围，远远地望着那个光芒万丈的女子，眉头微微皱了起来。
他并不认识金琉璃，但从在场众人的反应来看，这个女子在修仙界的地位恐怕比他想象的还要高得多。
可她为什么会和林天师兄他们一起过来？这是小说里完全没用的剧情啊！究竟是哪里不对？
“你们……是中州的人？这里是中州哪里？”金琉璃开口询问。
“道友，这里是中州的大周仙朝，我们在陨仙秘境里。”
content_en:
Chapter 255 Jin Liuli
"We were exploring the secret realm, and when we saw a teleportation array... we ended up here!"
"Teleportation array? Where are you from?"
"Eastern Region!"
"Eastern Region?" Everyone was shocked.
"Why is the teleportation array in the Eastern Region transmitted directly to the secret realm? Could it be that the seniors here also left inheritance in the Eastern Region?"
"Don't ask about those useless things! Boy, tell us, what's in it?"
"Well... we haven't looked carefully yet. We just saw a door and opened it to take a look. We didn't expect there to be so many seniors!"
"Are you two the only ones here?"
"That's not true."
Before Lin Tian finished speaking, there were footsteps again from the gate of the main hall.
This time the footsteps were more dense, and there were obviously a lot of people.
Then they saw a woman.
She walked in front of everyone.
At that moment, the noise outside the entire Fallen Immortal Palace suddenly stopped.
The Mahayana monks present, no matter which force they came from, no matter how arrogant they were on weekdays, their expressions froze when they saw that face.
That was a woman who looked to be no more than twenty years old.
Her beauty has a very aggressive and stunning look.
His facial features are as delicate as if they were carved from the finest spiritual jade. His eyebrows are like a distant mountain with a hint of daisy, his eyes are like the moon reflected in a cold pond, his nose is straight and delicate, and his expression is cold.
It's like nothing in the world can enter her eyes.
Her tall and slender figure was perfectly outlined by a tight-fitting suit.
Of course, her beauty did not shock everyone. What really shocked them was her cultivation.
The late Mahayana period!
A person who looks like a young girl in the late Mahayana period!
Fortunately, Zhongzhou is also a crouching tiger, hidden dragon, and there is no shortage of big forces. Someone soon recognized her.
"Jin Liuli...it's Jin Liuli! The legitimate daughter of the Jin family in the East Region!" A monk in the integration stage shouted out.
"Isn't the Jin family reclusive? Why did she even come to Zhongzhou?"
The person next to him lowered his voice, his tone full of shock.
"The legitimate daughter of the Jin family, she is 40 years old and in the late Mahayana stage... Oh my God, this kind of talent can't be saved. I have practiced for three hundred years before I reached the integration stage. She is already in the late Mahayana stage at the age of 40..."
"It wouldn't be surprising if the Jin family leads the team. A super family has such a background!"
As everyone began to discuss, more and more people appeared behind the door, but they were all dressed as servants.
Those servants all have restrained auras, but the trace of fluctuation that occasionally leaks out is at least the beginning of the middle stage of integration.
Lu Chen stood at the outermost edge of the crowd, looking at the radiant woman from a distance, frowning slightly.
He didn't know Jin Liuli, but judging from the reactions of everyone present, this woman's status in the world of immortality was probably much higher than he imagined.
But why did she come here with Senior Brother Lin Tian and the others? This is a completely useless plot in the novel! What's wrong?
"Are you... from Zhongzhou? Where is this place in Zhongzhou?" Jin Liuli asked.
"Fellow Taoist, this is the Great Zhou Immortal Dynasty in Zhongzhou, and we are in the secret realm of the Fallen Immortal."
